items.title: AXA personal lines grow 7% as AXA XL pulls back in soft market
items.summary: AXA reported a 3% rise in nine-month property and casualty premiums as growth in retail lines offset a deliberate contraction at AXA XL.

items.title: Ukraine reserves dent Hamilton’s Q3 underwriting profit
items.summary: Hamilton Insurance Group reported a sharp fall in third-quarter underwriting profit as reserve strengthening related to the Ukraine conflict pushed its combined ratio up to 97.3%.

items.title: MS Amlin launches AI tool to halve reinsurance wording reviews
items.summary: MS Amlin has introduced an internal AI tool called Wordy Bot to cut reinsurance contract review times ahead of the January 1 renewals.

items.title: Adrian Flux and TMHCC launch UK home cover for humanoid robots
items.summary: Adrian Flux and Tokio Marine HCC International have launched what they describe as the UK's first home insurance policy for domestic humanoid robots.

items.title: UK business confidence rises six points to 47% in October on stronger demand
items.summary: Lloyds Business Barometer shows overall business confidence sitting above its long-term average as economic optimism and trading outlooks improve.
